units: <cite ref="Tractate Derekh Eretz Rabbah 2:9">Treat. Der. Er. ch. II</cite> <he>מְדַבְּרֵי נ׳</he> those talking obscenely.
<cite ref="Tractate Derekh Eretz Rabbah 2:12">Ib.</cite> <he>הדר בנ׳ עם אשתו</he> who lives with his wife in an obscene manner; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="N00099"><he>נְבָלוֹת</he></cite>.

Ex. R. s. 24 (ref. to Deut. XXXII, 6) עם נבל שעשו נ׳ וכ׳ ‘a disgraced people’, for they did disgraceful things, as it is said (Ps. LXXIX, 2), they made ‘the disgraced’ of thy people food &c. (taking נִבְלַת as if from נְבָלָה).—2) destruction.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 38:10">Gen. R. s. 38</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 62:14">Yalk. ib. 62</cite> (play on <he>וְנָבְלָה</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 11:7">Gen. XI, 7</cite>) <he>משפתם אעשה</he> (<he>עמהם</he>) <he>נ׳</he> through their own lips I shall bring destruction upon them.
